stem: An insurance company runs Amazon EBS, Amazon RDS, and Amazon DynamoDB resources tagged by environment, and wants one policy-driven backup schedule that automatically protects all three resource types by tag and copies the backups to a second AWS Region for durability. Which service meets this requirement?

choices.text: EBS snapshots created individually through the EC2 console
Amazon DynamoDB point-in-time recovery enabled per table

rationale: AWS Backup centralizes one policy-driven backup plan across many resource types, including EBS, RDS, and DynamoDB, assigns resources to the plan by tag, and can copy backups to a second AWS Region, matching every part of this requirement in a single service. Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication only applies to S3 objects, not EBS, RDS, or DynamoDB resources. Creating EBS snapshots individually through the console covers only EBS, leaves RDS and DynamoDB unprotected, and is a manual process rather than one policy-driven schedule. DynamoDB point-in-time recovery only protects DynamoDB tables and does not extend to EBS or RDS, nor does it copy anything to a second Region by itself.
